warmup.name: Elephant walk
warmup.note: Hamstring nerve glide (movementbydavid step 1). Hinge forward, hands toward the floor, bend one knee, shift hips toward it so the other leg straightens. Tingling behind the straight knee is the point. Alternate.

warmup.name: Calf + soleus stretch
warmup.note: Ankle range for the deep squat. Calf: toes up on a plate, knee straight, lean in. Soleus: foot flat, push the knee past the toes as far as it goes. Knee past toes is good, not dangerous.

warmup.name: Supported deep squat hold
warmup.note: Hold a rack upright, sink as deep as the knee allows, heels down. Push knees forward and hips out. Right knee sets the depth: pressure is fine, a pinch means come up a bit.

warmup.name: Lunge pulses + couch stretch
warmup.dose: 10 pulses, then 30 s hold, per side
warmup.note: Half-kneeling, hands down, back toes anchored: lift the back knee off the floor, sink the hip, 10x. Then hold the couch stretch (or reach the arm up and over if couch is too much). Tuck the pelvis BEFORE you lean. You should feel it creep into the abs, never into the lower back.

warmup.name: Active hamstring stretch
warmup.note: Half-kneeling, front leg straight, heel down, hinge until you feel the stretch. Then PUSH the heel hard into the floor for the whole 30 s, so the hamstring works while it is long.

warmup.name: Kneeling rock-back
warmup.note: Knee flexion. On all fours with a pad under the knees, rock the hips back toward the heels with hands taking weight. Stop at pressure, never pain. Right knee: if your surgeon said flexion is mechanically blocked, rock only to where it stops and do not push.

warmup.name: 90/90 push-up
warmup.note: From 90/90, torso down over the front leg to the floor and back. Hands assist at first; goal is the glute lifting you unaided.

warmup.name: Elevated pancake
warmup.note: Replaces the straddle hold. Sit on a plate or step, legs wide, toes up, flat back, reach forward toward something at the same height. Track it: fingers, then elbows on the bench, then lower the seat.

A.session_notes: Preacher drop restarts at 35 (first drop stuck at 9 twice). Shoulder press up (top 70, back-off 60), leg curl 50, side bend 22.5. Pulldown down to 50 for clean form. Pec deck 45 holds. Pulldown: stop the set when form breaks, not when the arms do. Warm-up stays: hips, knees, hamstrings.

exercises.name: Shoulder Press - top set
exercises.notes: Machine: 65x5 was RPE 7 on 11-16 -> 70. Hold 70 until it is RPE 7, then 75. Barbell/DB variants: weights do not carry.

exercises.name: Shoulder Press - back-off
exercises.notes: Machine: 55x8 both sets, last at RPE 7 on 11-16 -> 60. Hold 60 until both sets are RPE 8 or less.

exercises.name: Seated Leg Curl
exercises.notes: 50x10 all three at RPE 8 on 11-16 (you went past the 45 target) -> 50 is the target now, 55 once it is RPE 7. Lean the torso forward so the hamstrings start long. 2 s on the way up. Let the right knee set how far you curl; the stretched part at the top matters more than the squeeze.

exercises.name: Lat Pulldown
exercises.notes: 55: 10, 10, 8 at RPE 10 and form broke again on 11-16 -> 50, your call. Back to 55 when all three sets are 10 clean reps. Full stretch at the top every rep: the lats are a big part of how wide your ribcage looks.

exercises.name: Pec Deck Fly
exercises.notes: 2 sets. 47x12 then 47x8 at RPE 10 on 11-16 with stricter technique -> 45 until both sets hit 12.

exercises.name: Side Bend
exercises.notes: NEW, obliques. One DB, free hand on your head. Lower toward the bell slowly (2 s), come up until you lean a little past vertical the other way. No twisting, no leaning back. 20x12 both sides at RPE 6 on 11-16 -> 22.5 kg DB (you hold 24 for 60 s at RPE 6). Any back twinge: stop the exercise and tell me. 45 deg version: bodyweight, hip on the pad, same rules.

exercises.name: Machine Preacher Curl (drop set)
exercises.notes: First drop was 9 at 40 on 11-08 AND 11-16, two sessions under the 10-12 target -> back to 35, then 25, then 15. All to failure. Back to 40 once the first drop hits 12.

B.session_notes: Bench top holds at 80 (you jumped +2.5/side, no 1.25 plates). Hip thrust 30 -> 35, reverse hack 30 for 2x10, woodchop 24. Hip Thrust stays 2nd, right after bench: it is your main glute lift. Short on time: cut the seated row, never the hip thrust.

exercises.name: Plate Loaded Bench Press - top set
exercises.notes: 80x3 at RPE 9 on 11-18 (you went +2.5 per side: no 1.25 plates). Hold 80 until it is RPE 7-8. Next jump is 85 (+2.5 per side), so add a 4th rep before that.

exercises.name: Plate Loaded Bench Press - back-off
exercises.notes: 62.5x7 both sets, RPE 8 on 11-18. Hold until both sets are RPE 7. First rep of each set paused 2 s.

exercises.name: Hip Thrust
exercises.notes: 30x12 x3 at RPE 7 on 11-18 -> 35. Chin tucked, shins vertical at the top, tuck the pelvis and squeeze 2 s, stop at neutral.

Hip thrust machine / glute drive.notes: No recent log: 40 is a starting guess, adjust on set 1 and log what you used. Chin tucked, squeeze 2 s at the top, stop at neutral.

exercises.name: Squat Machine
exercises.notes: 30x8 both sets at RPE 8 on 11-18 -> same 30, aim for 10 reps. At 2x10 go to 35 and back to 8.

exercises.name: Machine Seated Row
exercises.notes: 20x12 (3rd set not logged). Hold at 20 (your cap). First thing to cut if you are short on time.

exercises.name: Cable Woodchop
exercises.notes: High to low. Your call 11-18: stay at 18-24 until the technique is solid. Turn through the ribs, back heel pivots, hips quiet.

Low-to-high cable woodchop.notes: 30 then 24 at RPE 9 on 11-18. Your call: stay at 18-24 until the technique is solid.

exercises.name: Lying Incline DB Curl (drop set)
exercises.notes: Skipped on 11-18 (barbell curls in the hip-thrust rests instead, fine on a short day). Start at 12.5 -> 7.5 -> 5; the drop set is the stronger biceps hit when you have the 3 minutes.

C.session_notes: Hammer curl down to 15 x 10 (17.5 stalled with bad form). What changed: DB incline +2.5 (22.5), woodchop 24 on all sets, back extension 3x12. Pull-up top holds at 7.5 (RPE 8). Back extension is glute-biased (toes out, upper back rounded) and is your lower-glute builder. Wrist + reverse curl still go in the back extension rests.

exercises.name: Pull-Up Parallel Close Grip - top set
exercises.notes: +5 x5 was RPE 7, so +2.5 to 7.5. Stop the set AND the exercise on any catch in the back.

exercises.name: Pull-Up Parallel Close Grip - back-off
exercises.notes: Bodyweight 2x5 (RPE 7 on 11-02). Holds while the top set climbs.

exercises.name: 45 Back Extension (stop at neutral)
exercises.notes: NOW GLUTE-BIASED: toes turned out ~30 deg, pad just below the hip crease, upper back slightly rounded, chin tucked. Drive your hips into the pad with the glutes to come up, STOP AT NEUTRAL, never arch. 10/10/12 BW was RPE 7, so 12 reps. Once 3x12 is RPE 7, hold a 5 kg plate. Wrist + reverse curl superset in these rests.

exercises.name: DB Incline Bench Press
exercises.notes: 3x10 at 20 was RPE 7 on 11-15, so +2.5 to 22.5. If this gym tops out at 20 kg DBs, stay at 20 and go for 3x12.

exercises.name: Cable Woodchop
exercises.notes: NEW, replaces the Pallof press (a hold builds less muscle than a moving lift). High to low, arms long, turn through the ribs, back heel pivots, no arching, 2 s back up. 18/24/24 x12 was RPE 6, so 24 on all three sets. Log the stack number.

exercises.name: Hammer Curl
exercises.notes: Finisher, straight sets. 17.5 stalled twice (8/8/8 at RPE 10, bad form on 11-15) -> 15 x 10 with clean form. Back to 17.5 when all three sets hit 12.

D.session_notes: Suitcase hold goes to 30 kg x 75 s (30 x 60 was RPE 6). Dip holds at 5 (RPE 8), face pull holds at 45 (RPE 8), lateral raise holds at 7.5. Pull-through target is unchanged: you did the DB RDL instead (2 x 15, RPE 9, lower back felt it), and weights do not carry across variants. Squat machine is OUT and Cable Pull-Through replaces it (glutes and hamstrings, spine-friendly hinge). That leaves the squat on Day B only, so you can now do D the day after B.

exercises.name: Cable Pull-Through
exercises.notes: NEW. Rope on the low pulley, face away, rope between your legs. Push the hips back until the hamstrings are stretched, knees soft, then stand up by squeezing the glutes. Stop at neutral, no leaning back. The deep stretch at the bottom is what builds the lower glute. 25x12 was RPE 6 -> 30; if 12 is RPE 7 or easier, +5.

DB Romanian deadlift.notes: 15x12 x3 at RPE 9 on 11-17, felt in the lower back. Hold 15. Push the hips back, shins still, stop the set when you lose the glute squeeze.

exercises.name: Weighted Dip
exercises.notes: 5 kg 3x8 at RPE 8. Hold. Stop at ~90 degrees elbow, slight forward lean.

exercises.name: Face Pull
exercises.notes: 40x12 was RPE 7 -> 45 (you have used 45 before).

exercises.name: Suitcase Hold (straps)
exercises.notes: 3 sets for the obliques. 30 kg x 60 s per side was RPE 6, so 75 s now. If the gym has no 30, hold 27.5 for 75 s (log the weight). Stand tall, do not lean away from the bell.

Kettlebell.notes: 24 kg x 60 s at RPE 6 on 10-30 -> 75 s.

exercises.name: Lateral Raise (drop set)
exercises.notes: 7.5 -> 5 -> 2.5. 7.5 gave 11/10/10 at RPE 10, so it holds here.

H.session_notes: What changed: hip thrust moved up to 2nd, split squat 3 -> 2 sets and glute-biased, NEW sliding leg curl (hamstrings) and side plank hip dips (obliques). Pike and push-up are now one slot: pick pike if you are replacing Day A, a push-up if replacing B or C. Use this only to replace a missed gym day; it doesn't move the rotation. Every set ends 1-2 reps short of failure. Too easy (target at RPE 7)? Slow the lowering to 4-5 s or add a pause before adding reps. Warm-up at home: calf stretch on a stair, squat hold on a door frame, pancake sitting on a cushion.

exercises.name: Push
exercises.notes: Pike: 8, feet on bed for harder, head travels in front of the hands. Push-up variants: aim for 12, feet on bed if there is one, floor = 3 s down, 1 s chest on floor. End the set when the hips sag.

exercises.name: Single-leg Hip Thrust
exercises.notes: MOVED UP to slot 2, the main glute lift. Shoulders on bed or sofa (floor = glute bridge). Chin tucked, 2 s squeeze, ribs down, stop at neutral, never arch past straight.

exercises.name: Bulgarian Split Squat
exercises.notes: 2 sets now (was 3), and glute-biased: front foot a bit further out, torso leaned forward ~30 deg, push through the front heel. Rear foot on bed or chair, 3 s down, ribs down, never arch to go deeper. Knee sets the depth.

exercises.name: Pull
exercises.notes: Chin-up 8 (palms toward you), RPE 8 cap, stop on any catch. No bar: door-frame row 12 per side, feet closer to the frame = harder. Towel row: stand on the push-to-open side so pulling shuts the door.

exercises.name: Sliding Leg Curl
variants: Lowering only (both up, slide out 4 s)
exercises.notes: NEW, hamstrings. On your back, heels on a towel (hard floor) or in socks, hips up in a bridge. Slide the heels out slowly (3 s) keeping the hips up, then pull them back in. Can't pull back yet? Use 'lowering only': slide out, drop the hips, walk the feet back in. Right knee sets how far you curl in.

exercises.name: Side Plank Hip Dip
exercises.notes: NEW, obliques (the side plank left the warm-up). On the forearm, feet stacked, lower the hip toward the floor and lift it higher than straight, 2 s pause at the top. Too easy: hold a water bottle or bag on the top hip. No top-leg raise.
